title: KDP Margin Error: Minimum Margins and Gutter by Page Count | SparkPrep
h1: How to fix a KDP margin error (with the gutter table)
description: KDP says your text is outside the margins? Here are KDP's minimum margins and inside gutter for every page count, and how to set them in Word or InDesign.
lead: KDP's inside margin grows as your book gets thicker. Most margin errors come from using one margin for every book.
error: Text is outside the margins / content too close to the edge
errorNote: Paraphrased. KDP shows this in its print previewer before you can publish.
why:
The inside edge of each page (the gutter) disappears into the spine. Thicker books curve more, so KDP needs a bigger inside margin as the page count grows. The outside, top and bottom margins must be at least 0.25" (0.375" if your book has bleed).

Page countKDP minimum inside margin
24 to 1500.375"
151 to 3000.5"
301 to 5000.625"
501 to 7000.75"
701 to 8280.875"

Page numbers, headers and images count too. If anything sits closer to the edge than these numbers, KDP flags it.

steps: Set Inside to your number from the table, and Outside, Top and Bottom to at least 0.25" (we suggest 0.5" so text doesn't feel cramped).
Check headers and footers: Layout → Margins → Layout tab, and keep them inside the margins.
Save as PDF and upload again.
Layout → Margins and Columns (on the parent/master pages).
Set Inside and Outside using the table above.
Export with File → Export → Adobe PDF (Print).

cta.text: Don't want to redo your layout margin by margin? SparkPrep checks every page against KDP's table for your page count and moves your content back inside the safe area in minutes.

faq.q: What is the minimum gutter for KDP?
faq.a: 0.375 inches for 24 to 150 pages, 0.5 for 151 to 300, 0.625 for 301 to 500, 0.75 for 501 to 700 and 0.875 for 701 to 828 pages.
At least 0.25 inches without bleed and 0.375 inches with bleed, on the top, bottom and outside edges.

manual: Open your manuscript in Word (or InDesign).
Go to Layout → Margins → Custom Margins and set the inside (gutter) margin for your page count: 0.375" for 24–150 pages, 0.5" for 151–300, 0.625" for 301–500, 0.75" for 501–700, 0.875" for 701–828.
Set the outside, top and bottom margins to at least 0.25" (0.375" if your book has bleed), choose "Mirror margins", and check page numbers and headers sit inside them.
Re-export as a PDF at your exact trim size with all fonts embedded.
Re-upload it and wait for the review again (KDP says a review can take up to 72 hours).
